heading: Idea Ranch web design and development
description: Designed and developed brand websites, connecting information architecture, interaction flows, visual design, and implementation.

blocks.heading: Brand websites from structure to implementation
blocks.body:
At Idea Ranch I designed and developed websites for brands including Toyota, Remington, Christie Cookies Co, and Carhartt. I translated requirements into information architecture, interaction flows, visual design, and working web pages.

The work included wireframes and designs in Sketch and Photoshop, UX documentation for design and development teams, and information-architecture documents for large websites.
